description: Source code for sensor trigger handling in the wsen_pads driver, including interrupt setup, handling, and configuration.

methods.name: pads_setup_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Configures the data-ready GPIO interrupt on the device.

methods.name: pads_handle_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Handles a data-ready interrupt, disables further interrupts until processed.

methods.name: pads_process_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Invokes the data-ready handler if set and re-enables the interrupt.

methods.name: pads_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets or disables the data-ready trigger and manages interrupt configuration.

methods.name: pads_drdy_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on data-ready GPIO event, triggers interrupt handling.

methods.name: pads_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling data-ready interrupts if configured to run in its own thread.

methods.name: pads_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler for global thread configuration to process data-ready interrupts.

methods.name: pads_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt handling for the sensor device.
